theory_low.tarabunga-classification-six-gapped-clas: An abstract-level claim. Section III restricts to NN and NNN ansatze, giving 6 ansatze, and the classification rests on the PSG method in cited work [27-29, 45]. The text gives no theorem with proof; a derived result, not a proved result in this paper's own statement.
theory_low.tarabunga-psg-160-to-24-classes: The 160 count is cited from [45]. The reduction to 24 is a counting step the authors state and defer to App. B, with no theorem statement; not a proved result.
theory_low.tarabunga-six-ansatze-nn-nnn: Section III, p.3: the count of 6 follows from the PSG classification of cited work plus the authors' restriction to NN and NNN links. A reported count under a stated restriction, not a proved result.
theory_low.tarabunga-no-dirac-spin-liquid: Section III, p.3: a symmetry argument (the DSL submanifold preserves time-reversal, which the Hamiltonian breaks). Argued in text for this model, with no theorem or proof; the abstract wording is wider than the argument.
